ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The central and basal regions are dominated by a continuous low-intensity dark field. High-intensity white contiguous areas are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes. The right lobe tip shows a more extensive white field (approx. 15% of total fluke area) compared to the left tip (approx. 10% of total fluke area) which exhibits heavier black mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with a narrow base vertex; the calculated angle between the inner lobe boundaries is approximately 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge boundary. Features a sequence of sharp peaks (3-12 pixel amplitude) and shallow valleys, creating a jagged silhouette isolated against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Inner trailing edge shows a concave curve leading from the notch, transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of at least five distinct circular/annular low-contrast rings (dark outlines with light centers) located on the lower-left and lower-central dark regions of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions are visible on the extreme left margin and within the white region of the right lobe tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a dense cluster of high-relief, roughly circular light-colored masses (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme right-side trailing edge tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark circular spot (approx. 20x20 pixels) is visible within the high-intensity white field of the upper right lobe.
